text: Candidate rule: when the Owner supplies a concrete visual or presentation target, executable Product Truth should capture the relevant perspective/camera, recognisable player and opponent identity, environment depth/material/lighting expectations, combat readability such as weapons/shields/ground telegraphing, and the stated quality bar before Director design. Details not present in durable Owner input remain unknown rather than being retrospectively attributed to the Director.

validationEvidence.note: Generic held-out visual-target coverage gap reproduced, but the specific late Titan isometric/mech targets were absent from the durable authorized brief.
